abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Argus' abilities apply a stack of Disintegration for 2s, causing subsequent instances of ability damage to deal 4 (+3%) bonus magical damage. Each stack of Disintegration deals 50% more damage, stacking infinitely (capped at 12 against Monsters).

abilities.name: Arcrune Conduit
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 55 (+55%) physical damage.

abilities.name: Dread Nova
abilities.description: Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy. Upon landing it explodes, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+50%) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

abilities.name: Ether Crystal
abilities.description: Argus summons an Ether Crystal at the target location for 2s. The Crystal will Push Enemy Heroes from the center and Lift Allied Heroes into the air before producing a storm that deals 15/25/35/45/55 (+18%) magical damage every 0.5s to nearby Enemies and Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.5s. After the duration the Crystal will implode, Pulling all Enemies within to the center.

abilities.name: Particle Shredder
abilities.description: Argus fires homing projectiles from his Abyssal Staff for up to 3.5s. Each projectile consumes mana and deals 13/20/27/34/41 (+18%) per blast. At maximum rank, Particle Shredder can be used indefinitely.

abilities.name: Synaptic Obliterator
abilities.description: After a short delay, Argus channels for up to 8s, gaining immunity to pushes and pulls whilst deploying his ultimate weapon to fire up to 3/4/5 powerful Energy Beams. Each beam deals 100/130/160 (+25%) magical damage (increased by up to 150% based on the Target's missing health) and Slows Enemies hit by 60% for 0.5s.

augments.name: Arcane Engine
augments.description: Dealing Ability Damage to Heroes grants you 1.75% Movement Speed for 1.5s, stacking infinitely - 0.15s CD.

augments.name: Mana Catalyst
augments.description: Restore Mana equal to 10% of damage dealt to Heroes, reduced to 1.5% for Non-Heroes. Basic Attacks restore 2x more.

augments.name: Infinite Obliteration
augments.description: Synaptic Obliterator's projectile now have infinite range, travel 25% faster, and Slow for 50% longer.

abilities.name: Fate
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 53.0/55.4/57.9/60.5/63.3/66.2/69.2/72.3/75.6/79.0/82.5/86.2/90.0/93.9/97.9/102.1/106.4/110.8 (+85% physical power) physical damage. The final round will always critically strike. After four basic attacks, Revenant will automatically reload.

abilities.name: Bounty Hunter
abilities.description: Revenant's Physical Power is increased by 3.0/3.6/4.2/4.8/5.4/6.0/6.6/7.2/7.8/8.4/9.0/9.6/10.2/10.8/11.4/12.0/12.6/13.2% (+1% per 10% Critical Strike Chance)(+2% per 10% Bonus Attack Speed). Killing an Enemy Hero grants 25 (+25 per bounty stack) additional gold.

abilities.name: Obliterate
abilities.description: Unleash 10 ethereal missiles within a wide cone that home towards random Enemies. If a Target is Marked by Scar, the missiles prioritize them instead. Each missile deals 35.0/50.0/65.0/80.0/95.0 (+40.0/55.0/70.0/85.0/100.0% physical power) (+60.0/65.0/70.0/75.0/80.0% magical power) physical damage. Enemy Heroes and Monsters take 10% damage from missiles beyond the first.

abilities.name: Scar
abilities.description: Launch a cursed orb that deals 15.0/20.0/25.0/30.0/35.0 (+20% physical power) (+30% magical power) physical damage and apply 4 stacks of Marked for 6s. Dealing damage to a Marked Target deals 15.0/20.0/25.0/30.0/35.0 (+20% physical power) (+30% magical power) physical damage and consumes a stack. Upon consuming all stacks, the Target is Rooted for 1s.

abilities.name: Hellfire Rounds
abilities.description: Passive: Critical Damage is modified to 150.0/152.0/154.0/156.0/158.0/160.0%. Hand Cannon's final round deals bonus physical damage equal to 5.0/6.0/7.0/8.0/9.0/10.0% (+0.5% per Level) (+0.02% magical power) of the Target's missing health and removes Revenant's combat penalty if it hits, granting him 10% (+18% attack speed) Movement Speed for 2s. Active: Revenant reloads his Hand Cannon.

abilities.name: Reckoning
abilities.description: Revenant pulls himself and his Target into the Nether Realm for 6.0/7.0/8.0s and Slows them by 80% for 0.7s. During this time, he steals 8.0/9.0/10.0% of their Physical & Magical Power. Killing his opponent inside the Nether Realm grants 2x the bonus gold gained from Bounty Hunter.

augments.name: Quickdraw
augments.description: Revenant reloads 35% faster and jumps 25% higher.

augments.name: Spectral Bounty
augments.description: Reckoning now grants 3x Bounty Hunter gold and 4 (+25% of stolen stats) Physical & Magical Power on Kill.

augments.name: Hellfire Blast
augments.description: Helllfire Rounds' Fourth Shot deals 7% more damage and ignores 30% Bonus Physical Armor.
